settings.title: A conversation, not a pitch
settings.text: Tell us the occasion, the budget, and the taste you're designing for. No pressure, ever.

settings.title: See real stones and pieces
settings.text: We bring options to the table — natural stones, estate finds, or sketches for a commission.

settings.title: Made and delivered with care
settings.text: Commissions are crafted in Italy and delivered fully insured, with documentation.

settings.title: Book a Consultation
settings.intro: Whether you're marking a milestone, commissioning something entirely your own, or searching for a specific stone — begin with a conversation. In person in New York, or by video from anywhere.
